mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces present value of corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) drop of more than 10% in the same month indicates weakening aggregate demand, which depresses earnings expectations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < -2% AND HOUST < previous month - 10%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase of more than 0.4 percentage points from the previous month, sustained for two consecutive months, signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods at 90% confidence, or the mechanism fails during a wage inflation spike.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% for three consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings and capital expenditure, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month - 0.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 35% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate below 2% combined with a concurrent rise in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% YoY signals a monetary policy lag and inflation surprise, which erodes real purchasing power and triggers equity volatility, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal income (proxied by PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month) combined with a concurrent rise in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals robust demand expansion, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month + 0.5% AND HOUST > previous month + 5%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods at 90% confidence, or the mechanism fails during a concurrent monetary tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) above 0.8% for four consecutive months signals strong labor market momentum, which supports consumer spending and corporate profitability, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods at 95% confidence, or the mechanism fails during a simultaneous sharp rise in unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive two-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.6% signals a recovery in manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate earnings and capital spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in non-recessionary regimes.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > previous month + 0.6% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods at 90% confidence, or the mechanism fails during a simultaneous collapse in consumer demand.
